title: ERFVII and MynOx Regulation in Arabidopsis and MATα W303 cells
summary: This cluster revolves around the regulation of ERFVII and MynOx in Arabidopsis and MATα W303 cells. ERFVII binds to the Mediator complex and regulates several genes, including PCO, PCO4, and UbSYRAP. MynOx is expressed in Arabidopsis and contains MATα W303 cells. The regulation of ERFVII and MynOx is further influenced by the presence of PCO4 module and the activity of UbSYRAP, which binds to HRPE1, HRPE2, and HRPE3. The cluster also includes the degradation of UbSYRAP by PCO1 and the induction of PCO by UbSYRAP.
